# Branding API

7 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/branding`

Get branding settings

Global admins only. Effective values plus the configured defaults and which fields are runtime overrides.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Branding state | `application/json`: [BrandingAdmin](schemas.md#brandingadmin) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `PUT /api/v1/admin/branding`

Update branding settings

Global admins only. Runtime overrides win over the branding.* configuration until reset.

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [BrandingUpdate](schemas.md#brandingupdate)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Branding state | `application/json`: [BrandingAdmin](schemas.md#brandingadmin) |
| `400` | Invalid value | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/admin/branding`

Reset branding to the defaults

Global admins only. Removes every runtime override, including uploaded images.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Branding state | `application/json`: [BrandingAdmin](schemas.md#brandingadmin) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `PUT /api/v1/admin/branding/{asset}`

Upload a branding image

Global admins only. The raw request body is the image: Content-Type image/png or image/svg+xml, at most 512 KiB (PNG at most 2048x2048). SVG is sanitised (scripts, event handlers, external references, foreignObject and anything outside an allowlist are removed) and rejected when it cannot be made safe.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asset` | path | string | yes | One of: `logo-light`, `logo-dark`, `favicon`. |

**Request body** (required)

`image/png`: string (binary)

`image/svg+xml`: string (binary)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Branding state | `application/json`: [BrandingAdmin](schemas.md#brandingadmin) |
| `400` | Not a valid PNG or SVG, or the SVG is unsafe | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `413` | Image larger than 512 KiB | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `DELETE /api/v1/admin/branding/{asset}`

Remove an uploaded branding image

Global admins only. Falls back to the configured file, else the built-in image.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asset` | path | string | yes | One of: `logo-light`, `logo-dark`, `favicon`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Branding state | `application/json`: [BrandingAdmin](schemas.md#brandingadmin) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `GET /api/v1/branding`

Get branding

Unauthenticated: the login page needs it before sign-in. Answers ETag/304; shared caches may store it only for requests that carry no credentials.

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Effective branding Headers: `ETag`. | `application/json`: [Branding](schemas.md#branding) |
| `304` | Not modified | - |

### `GET /api/v1/branding/{asset}`

Get a branding image

The effective logo-light, logo-dark or favicon (PNG or sanitised SVG). 404 when none is configured. Served with a restrictive Content-Security-Policy and nosniff.

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asset` | path | string | yes | One of: `logo-light`, `logo-dark`, `favicon`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Image | `image/png`: string (binary); `image/svg+xml`: string (binary) |
| `304` | Not modified | - |
| `404` | No image configured | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
